name: Arquivo.pt (Portuguese web archive)
operator: Arquivo.pt, a public service of FCT (Fundacao para a Ciencia e a Tecnologia, Portugal)
tier_rationale: Public web archive run by FCT, a Portuguese government research agency, with published terms (A8 trusted); P059 'All archives are established non-profits or public bodies: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Captures are faithful records of what was served at capture time; coverage is mostly Portuguese-language sites, so a miss is never 'never archived'.

cdx.title: Arquivo.pt CDX server (wayback/cdx, NDJSON) and raw replay wayback/{timestamp}id_/{url}

terms.quote: Registry terms (A1 BR3): the Internet Archive (Wayback CDX and availability), Arquivo.pt (FCT public service), Common Crawl (free terms of use) and CarbonDate (ODU academic service) are 'open', each recorded by legal with evidence

cdx.notes: Quote: binding council text (P059 cond 10). The terms page (checked 2026-11-26) reads: 'Access to the contents is available free-of-charge and is intended to support for work of an educational, scientific or research nature. Use for commercial purposes is strictly forbidden.' and asks users to cite '[source: Arquivo.pt, dd/mm/yyyy]'. The council recorded internal CTI research as the purpose (as for the Internet Archive); legal to confirm on the next doctor --licences review (backlog p1-G01-2). Endpoints: https://arquivo.pt/wayback/cdx?url={url}&output=json&limit={n} (NDJSON, empty body = no captures) and https://arquivo.pt/wayback/{timestamp}id_/{url} (research C0155, verified 2026-11-26). Queried for .br/.pt and Portuguese-language sites and as the fallback when web.archive.org is unreachable (P059 cond 2).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G01-2 (P059, module web_archives). Polite use: 2 s between requests, 24 h cache; no published rate limit.
